f(f(x) + x + y) = f(x + y) + y f(y) \quad \text{for all } x, y \in \mathbb{R}.

Substitute into the equation: \[
f(c + x + y) = c = f(x + y) + y c = c + y c.

sentence:

c = c + y c \implies y c = 0 \quad \forall y \in \mathbb{R}.
